title: EU AI Office Enforcement Priorities Q4 2026 -- First High-Risk Wave and Deadlines
context: 2026-08-29 engine cycle -- EU AI Office (established under AI Act Art 64-70) operational in Brussels with first enforcement wave targeting high-risk AI systems from Q4 2026
body: The European Artificial Intelligence Office transitions from policy design to active enforcement in Q4 2026. This is the quarter where the AI Act's post-market monitoring obligations (Art 49), database registration requirements (Art 64), and conformity assessment documentation (Art 43) become enforceable against high-risk AI deployers that entered the market after the August 2026 application date. For a verification-first operator, the enforcement priority is significant because the AI Office has signalled it will not accept self-declared compliance without auditable evidence. A deployer who can produce a chain of signed measurement records -- per-axis attestations covering governance, care, refusal safety, detector interoperability, and sandbox-escape resilience -- arrives at an AI Office inquiry carrying a Verified Measurement Credential rather than a policy document. The Council of AI positions this enforcement window as the answer-first moment: the Q4 2026 enforcement wave rewards operators who invested in measurement infrastructure before the deadline, not those who scramble to assemble paper compliance after receiving a request for information. Key signals to watch: the AI Office's first batch of formal requests under Art 64(3) database registration; the publication of the first Art 71 penalty decisions establishing the precedent for 'proportionate and dissuasive' fines; and the coordinated action framework with national market surveillance authorities. The AI Office is also expected to issue horizontal guidance on general-purpose AI model obligations (Art 52-55) which will shape the compliance expectations for GPAI providers integrating into high-risk supply chains.
references: EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689), Art 64-70 (AI Office establishment)
